titulo: Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly played Taylor Swift’s No Body, No Crime during body disposal, court told
cuerpo: Friend of accused double murderer tells supreme court that van had lemony smell and blue tarp in back before Bunnings stop Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon played Taylor Swift’s song No Body, No Crime while attempting to dispose of two corpses, a court has heard. The NSW supreme court has been told he was driving to Bungonia with a friend when the song was played in the van. Continue reading...
